_meta.definition: The process of recording, analyzing, and comparing team and player statistics in baseball.

SeriesPost._description: Records post-series outcomes for baseball games between teams within a league in a specific year.

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: round
columns.description: Stores the round number of the World Series.

columns.name: teamIDwinner
columns.description: Stores the identifying code of the winning baseball team in a series post.

columns.name: lgIDwinner
columns.description: Stores the initials of the winning league (NL, AA) in baseball series postings.

columns.name: teamIDloser
columns.description: Stores the ID of the losing team in a baseball series (up to 10 characters, abbreviated).

columns.name: lgIDloser
columns.description: Stores the identifier of the losing league in a baseball series.

columns.name: wins
columns.description: Stores the number of wins by teams in a baseball series.

columns.name: losses
columns.description: Stores count of losses for a series.

columns.name: ties
columns.description: Stores count of ties in baseball series.
